start_frame: Low close at flagstone level: Alice biting a corner off the cake, her face held whole and undistorted, the hall soft and dark behind her.
end_frame: The same frame as her free hand claps flat on top of her head, anxiously feeling for which way she is going — bite and hand inside the one frame.
constraint_honoured: 'The bite and the hand happen inside one frame so the anxiety is a single gesture. Two words, fast.'
movement_note: 3.0 s and two words; a move would split a gesture the constraint requires to be single. 50 mm because her face is close at ten-inch scale.
